name: Protein Smoothies, Plant-Based Style
instructions: Use a plant-based protein powder (pea, soy, or a blended plant protein) or a spoonful of nut butter as your protein source.
Add oats or a banana for extra staying power alongside the protein.
Blend longer than you think you need to -- plant proteins can be slightly grainier and benefit from extra blending time.
Watch today's video for smoothie recipes, then swap in a plant-based protein source.
